name: Set of Points
description: Convexity of a set of points on the plane is the size of the largest subset of points that form a convex polygon. Your task is to build a set of n points with the convexity of exactly m . Your set of points should not contain three points that lie on a straight line.
input_specification: The single line contains two integers n and m ( 3 ≤ m ≤ 100, m ≤ n ≤ 2 m ).
output_specification: If there is no solution, print " -1 ". Otherwise, print n pairs of integers — the coordinates of points of any set with the convexity of m . The coordinates shouldn't exceed 10 8 in their absolute value.
